subject.title: feat(slack): statusReactions activation mode for work-gated lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw add a global `messages.statusReactions.activation` contract that initially affects only Slack, or should this behavior remain Slack-owned or be deferred until shared channel semantics exist?
rationale: The option creates new global configuration and presentation policy, while repository guidance sets a high bar for config growth and assigns channel-specific behavior to its owning plugin.

options.title: Approve shared activation semantics
options.body: Accept the global enum as a deliberate cross-channel contract, document its current Slack-only support, and keep the implementation backward-compatible.

options.title: Keep the policy Slack-owned
options.body: Move the activation choice under Slack configuration so other channels do not expose an ignored global setting.

options.title: Defer the new mode
options.body: Keep the existing acknowledgement, typing-reaction, lifecycle, and native-status surfaces until maintainers want another presentation policy.

recommendation.title: Approve shared activation semantics
recommendation.body: Accept the global enum as a deliberate cross-channel contract, document its current Slack-only support, and keep the implementation backward-compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work set Slack's acknowledgement and native status behavior, making this the closest product-direction ownership signal.
